title: soc2-control-mapping-draft-lina-zhou
content:
Quick notes / working mapping for SOC2 control inventory (scratchpad)

Goal: produce a minimal, reviewable control mapping table and evidence list we can hand to the auditor by end of Q1. This is a personal draft - will sync with Maya/Ryan/Samira and move to shared Confluence.

High-level: start with common SOC2 areas we get asked about: Access Controls (logical), Change Management, System Configuration & Hardening, Backup & Recovery, Logging & Monitoring, Vendor Management, Incident Response, Encryption & Key Management.

Open questions (needs follow-up):
- Confirm canonical owner list for each control. Who "owns" CC6/CC7 coverage? (Platform infra vs SRE vs Product infra)
- Where do we store historical evidence (screenshots, policy docs)? GitHub repo vs Confluence attachments vs S3 evidence-bucket. Auditor prefers immutable evidence; confirm retention policy.
- Need to reconcile ticket refs: SEC-342 vs SEC-357 (are they duplicates?).

Control mapping (working, not final):

1) Logical access controls / user provisioning (IAM)
- Control: Ensure unique user IDs, least privilege, timely removal on termination
- Current evidence: Okta SCIM provisioning config (screenshots + provisioning logs), access review policy doc (drive link), user deprovision runbook (internal playbook).
- Evidence locations: Confluence page (linked_artifacts[0]) for policy; GitHub repo security-evidence for scripts; Okta admin logs (exported CSVs).
- Owner: Identity team / DevOps (Maya Singh)
- Gaps: need documented quarterly access review meeting minutes for last 2 quarters. Action: ask Maya to pull meeting notes and export last review CSV (SEC-342 ticket).

2) Change management / code deployment controls
- Control: Authorized change process, code reviews, rollback capability, approvals for prod deploys
- Current evidence: GitHub protected branch settings (screenshot), PR approval rules (2 approvers), deployment runbook, logs from CI (build + deploy pipelines).
- Evidence locations: GitHub repo + CI logs (buildkite/circle) stored in artifacts bucket (need confirmation).
- Owner: Platform Engineering (Ryan Chen)
- Gaps: missing traceable approval evidence for hotfix deploy on 2023-11-01 - need to locate PR and approval comments. Action: Ryan to tag PR and attach to evidence folder.

3) System configuration & hardening (hosts, images)
- Control: baseline images, patching cadence, CME (configuration management) enforcement
- Current evidence: AMI build pipeline documentation, vulnerability scan reports (Aqua/Trivy exports), configuration drift alerts (Chef/Ansible/terraform-checks).
- Owner: Infra / Release Engineering (Samira Ahmed)
- Gaps: older images in staging found in scan (action: schedule remediation and capture scan after remediation).

4) Logging & monitoring / detection
- Control: Centralized logging, retention policy, alerting + triage workflow
- Evidence: ELK/Datadog dashboards screenshots, alert runbook, pager duty incident on 2024-01-15 (postmortem).
- Owner: Observability team / SRE (TBD)
- Gaps: retention policy doc needs sign-off and evidence of enforcement (log archival job). Action: ask observability to export retention config and recent archive logs.

5) Backup & recovery
- Control: backup schedules, periodic restores, RTO/RPO defined
- Evidence: backup reports (daily), restore test runbook and results (last test 2023-09-20).
- Owner: Infrastructure / SRE
- Gaps: need a formalized restore test report for last 12 months - schedule test and capture report.

6) Vendor management / subservice organizations
- Control: inventory of third party services, contracts, security questionnaires
- Evidence: vendor inventory spreadsheet (drive), latest vendor security attestation (where available), SOC2 of critical vendors (if provided).
- Owner: Legal/GTM + Security
- Gaps: Missing attestation for analytics vendor; action: procurement to request evidence (PR: SEC-357).

7) Incident response / forensics
- Control: IR plan, communication playbooks, post-incident reviews
- Evidence: IR plan doc, recent incident postmortem (2024-01-15), IR tabletop exercise notes (2023-10).
- Owner: Security & SRE
- Gaps: need evidence of tabletop participants and sign-in sheet for 2023-10 exercise. Action: Samira to check calendar invites and attendance list.

8) Encryption & key management
- Control: encryption at rest/in transit, KMS usage and key rotation
- Evidence: KMS configs (GCP KMS screenshots), TLS cert inventory, encryption policy doc
- Owner: Security infra
- Gaps: rotation logs for customer keys - confirm retention and rotation cadence.

Quick plan / next steps:
- Today: clean up this draft and create a Confluence page (template) with the table above. Attach known evidence links. (Action owner: Lina)
- This week: sync with Maya / Ryan / Samira to assign outstanding evidence tasks (owners + due dates).
- SEC tracker: consolidate SEC-342 / SEC-357 into single list and link PRs. Use GitHub repo security-evidence to store artifacts; create snapshot zip for auditor.
- By 2024-03-15: complete missing items for IAM and Change Mgmt; capture meeting minutes + screenshots.

Notes to self:
- Keep copies of screenshots + export logs in security-evidence repo with immutable tags/releases (better than Confluence attachments).
- When in doubt, add ticket refs to evidence files metadata (PR body/Jira link).
- Auditors like a single index file that lists each control, evidence link, owner, date - start building that in a CSV or Confluence table.

References / links:
- Confluence control mapping (draft): https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SEC/pages/12345/SOC2+Control+Mapping
- SEC-342 (access review remediation)
- security-evidence repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/security-evidence

-- end scratchpad --
